reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the QR lab report on the box and sachets, which is a nice touch, but then I did the math: $29.99 for 30 days is a dollar a day, and I can get magnesium bisglycinate for a fraction of that. A brand with zero reviews doesn't get a dollar a day from me.
objection: It is 2 capsules a day and nothing tells me how big they are. I have left bad reviews on huge capsules, and with no reviews I can't check. The Complex has citrate in it, which gives me cramps, so I would only look at the Bisglycinate, and even that is expensive per serving for something unproven.
would_change_my_mind: A real capsule size shown in the photos or a few dozen honest reviews saying the capsules are easy to swallow, plus a price closer to $18-20 for 30 days or a launch deal.
